# Incident report INC-2222

Severity: SEV2
Date: 2025-07-07

Summary: Complete outage affecting the Mailer Service. The incident lasted 178 minutes before full recovery. Root cause was determined to be a database failover. This report was written by Priya Ortega. Structured logs include the request path, status code and duration. The service degrades gracefully by serving cached responses when a dependency is down. Load tests run nightly against the staging environment. Backups are taken daily and verified weekly by restoring to a scratch cluster. The runbook is reviewed quarterly by the owning team. Rate limiting is enforced at the gateway with a token bucket per client. Requests carry a correlation id that is propagated to downstream calls.
